lines.text: God says Israel will no longer quote the sour grapes proverb, because every soul is His and the sinner dies.
A righteous man who does not rob, oppress, or look to idols, and keeps God's statutes, will surely live.
The righteous man's violent son eats at the altar, oppresses the poor and needy, and will surely die.
The violent man's son sees his father's sins and does not copy them, so he lives while his father dies.
God will judge each according to his ways and tells Israel to fashion a new heart and a new covenant.
